justifications.type_expressiveness: RomanError is a well-modeled enum with distinguishing variants and InvalidChar carries the offending char, though the (value, &str) tuple table could be a typed const struct.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with meaningful variants and no panics in library code, but no documentation comments and the canonical check relies on a slightly indirect round-trip strategy without explanatory rationale.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Has Debug/Display/Clone/Eq derives on the error and a clean signature, but there are no doc comments on any public item, which is a notable gap for a public API.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses iterators, ?, derives, and checked arithmetic appropriately, though collecting chars into a Vec and indexing with a manual while loop is less idiomatic than a windowed iterator approach.
